sections.title: 典例 1 - Grain Buds (小满)
raw_text: The traditional Chinese calendar divides the year into 24 solar terms (节气).
Thousands of years ago, they 1. ________ (create) to help with farming, but the solar term culture is still very 2. ________ (use) today to people's life.
Grain Buds is 3. ________ eighth solar term of a year.
It means that the seeds from the grain are becoming full but are not ripe.
This year Grain Buds falls 4. ________ May 21st, and lasts 16 days.
Here are some things you may not know about Grain Buds.
# A good season for eating fish
A saying about rain during this time says, "A heavy rainfall makes the river full."
Because of a lot of rain, rivers are full of water and a great number of fish.
You can't miss the chance 5. ________ (enjoy) them.
Also, it is such a golden season for 6. ________ (fisherman)!
# Suggestions on health
Wet and hot days 7. ________ (be) common in this season.
It may make you get skin illnesses easily.
It is necessary to take more exercise.
Walking, jogging and practicing tai chi are popular.
# A key period for flower caring
It is a good period for flowers to grow 8. ________ (rapid).
Caring for your garden becomes even 9. ________ (important) than any other time.
10. ________ you take good care of them, your plants will be healthier.

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般过去时的被动语态
questions.explanation: they 指代 24 solar terms，与 create 为被动关系，由 Thousands of years ago 可知用一般过去时的被动语态，主语为复数，助动词用 were，故填 were created。
questions.rule_summary: 一般过去时被动语态结构：was/were + 过去分词。

questions.explanation: is very 后接形容词作表语，表达节气文化在今天对人们生活仍很有用，填形容词 useful。
questions.rule_summary: 系动词 + 副词 + 形容词作表语；use 派生为形容词 useful。

questions.explanation: eighth 是序数词，表示第八个节气，序数词前必须加定冠词 the。
questions.rule_summary: 序数词前面通常要加定冠词 the。

questions.explanation: May 21st 是具体的某一天，具体日期前时间介词用 on。
questions.rule_summary: 具体某一天、具体日期的上午/下午等时间前介词用 on。

questions.explanation: the chance to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为做某事的机会，此处用动词不定式 to enjoy 作名词 chance 的后置定语。
questions.rule_summary: the chance / way / time to do sth. 不定式作后置定语。

questions.explanation: fisherman 为可数名词，此处表示泛指这类人群，应使用复数形式 fishermen。
questions.rule_summary: man/woman 结尾的可数名词变复数通常将 man 变为 men。

questions.explanation: 叙述客观季节规律用一般现在时，主语 Wet and hot days 为复数概念，be 动词用 are。
questions.rule_summary: 一般现在时复数主语对应的 be 动词用 are。

questions.explanation: 修饰动词 grow 需要用副词，形容词 rapid 的副词形式为 rapidly（迅速地）。
questions.rule_summary: 副词修饰动词，形容词 rapid 加 -ly 变副词 rapidly。

questions.explanation: 由 even 及空后的 than 可知此处需要用比较级，important 的比较级为 more important。
questions.rule_summary: even 修饰比较级；多音节形容词比较级在其前加 more。

questions.grammar_point_name: 条件状语从句从属连词 (If)
questions.explanation: you take good care of them 是植物会更健康的假设条件，用 If 引导条件状语从句，句首首字母大写。
questions.rule_summary: if 引导条件状语从句，意为如果。

filled_text: The traditional Chinese calendar divides the year into 24 solar terms.
Thousands of years ago, they were created to help with farming, but the solar term culture is still very useful today to people's life.
Grain Buds is the eighth solar term of a year.
It means that the seeds from the grain are becoming full but are not ripe.
This year Grain Buds falls on May 21st, and lasts 16 days.
Here are some things you may not know about Grain Buds.
# A good season for eating fish
A saying about rain during this time says, "A heavy rainfall makes the river full."
Because of a lot of rain, rivers are full of water and a great number of fish.
You can't miss the chance to enjoy them.
Also, it is such a golden season for fishermen!
# Suggestions on health
Wet and hot days are common in this season.
It may make you get skin illnesses easily.
It is necessary to take more exercise.
Walking, jogging and practicing tai chi are popular.
# A key period for flower caring
It is a good period for flowers to grow rapidly.
Caring for your garden becomes even more important than any other time.
If you take good care of them, your plants will be healthier.
filled_text_cn: 中国传统农历将一年划分为24个节气。
几千年前，它们的创立是为了辅助农耕，但节气文化在今天对人们的生活仍然非常有用。
小满是一年中的第八个节气。
这意味着谷物里的种子开始饱满，但还没有成熟。
今年小满在5月21日，持续16天。
以下关于小满，有一些你可能不知道的事情。
# 吃鱼的好季节
有一句关于这段时间降雨的俗语说：“大雨满河生。”
因为雨水很多，河里蓄满了水，也有大量的鱼。
你可不能错过享用它们的绝佳机会。
此外，这也是渔民们大丰收的黄金季节！
# 健康建议
潮湿闷热的日子在这个季节很常见。
这可能会让你很容易患上皮肤病。
进行更多的锻炼是很有必要的。
散步、慢跑和练习太极拳都很受欢迎。
# 照顾花卉的关键时期
这是花卉迅速生长的良好时期。
照料你的花园变得比以往任何时候都更加重要。
如果你好好照顾它们，你的植物就会更健康。

sections.title: 典例 2 - The Dragon Boat Festival (端午节)
raw_text: Dear Millie,
You asked me about the Dragon Boat Festival.
Now let me tell you something about it.
The Dragon Boat Festival is a traditional Chinese festival we Chinese 11. ________ (celebrate) for over 2, 000 years.
It's one of the three most important lunar festivals in China, along with the Spring Festival and the Mid-Autumn Festival.
The Dragon Boat Festival takes place on the 12. ________ (twenty-two) of June this year.
Throughout the years, many stories have been told about the 13. ________ (begin) of this festival.
Among them, 14. ________ (famous) one is about Qu Yuan, a well-known scholar in ancient China.
He not only 15. ________ (write) good poems but also gave suggestions to the king.
16. ________ he devoted himself to his country, the king didn't like him.
This great person drowned (溺水) himself in the Miluo River on the 5th day of the 5th Chinese lunar month because his Chu State fell to Qin State.
Local people tried to save him or find his body, but they didn't 17. ________ (success).
Qu Yuan was later considered as 18. ________ national hero.
To remember him, every fifth day of the fifth lunar month, people beat drums and go boat racing on the river as they once did 19. ________ (keep) fish away from his body.
Dragon boat racing is one of the most important customs Chinese people practice to celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival.
This activity 20. ________ (hold) widely in China's southern and southeastern areas where there are lots of rivers and lakes.
Lots of love,
Wendy

questions.explanation: 由时间状语 for over 2,000 years 可知动作从过去持续到现在，应用现在完成时，主语 we 为复数，故填 have celebrated。
questions.rule_summary: 现在完成时结构：have/has + 过去分词，常与 for + 时间段连用。

questions.explanation: the... of June 表示六月的具体某一天，应用序数词 twenty-second。
questions.rule_summary: 表示日期时用序数词，twenty-two 的序数词是 twenty-second。

questions.explanation: the beginning of... 为固定短语，意为……的开始/由来，定冠词 the 与介词 of 之间填名词 beginning。
questions.rule_summary: the + 名词 + of 结构；begin 派生名词为 beginning（双写 n 加 ing）。

questions.explanation: 由范围状语 Among them 可知三者及以上比较应用最高级，最高级前必须加定冠词 the，故填 the most famous。
questions.rule_summary: 表示三者或三者以上范围 (among / in / of) 时用最高级，形容词最高级前加 the。

questions.explanation: and 与 gave suggestions 构成并列谓语，讲述屈原生平历史事实，时态为一般过去时，write 的过去式为 wrote。
questions.rule_summary: not only... but also... 连接并列谓语动词，时态须保持一致。

questions.grammar_point_name: 让步状语从句从属连词 (Although/Though)
questions.explanation: 前半句他效忠国家与后半句国王不喜欢他之间存在让步转折关系，用 Although 或 Though 引导让步状语从句，句首大写。
questions.rule_summary: although / though 引导让步状语从句，意为虽然；尽管。

questions.explanation: 助动词 didn't 后必须接动词原形，success 是名词，其动词原形为 succeed。
questions.rule_summary: didn't + 动词原形；success(名) -> succeed(动)。

questions.explanation: 此处泛指屈原被视作一位民族英雄，national 以辅音音素开头，故填不定冠词 a。
questions.rule_summary: 辅音音素开头的单数可数名词前泛指用不定冠词 a。

questions.explanation: 划船赛龙舟的目的是为了让鱼远离他的遗体，动词不定式 to keep 作目的状语。
questions.rule_summary: 不定式 (to do) 常用作目的状语，意为为了……。

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般现在时的被动语态
questions.explanation: 主语 This activity 与 hold 是被动关系，描述普遍习俗与客观现状用一般现在时的被动语态，主语为单数，be 动词用 is，故填 is held。
questions.rule_summary: 一般现在时被动语态结构：is/am/are + 过去分词；hold 的过去分词是 held。

filled_text: Dear Millie,
You asked me about the Dragon Boat Festival.
Now let me tell you something about it.
The Dragon Boat Festival is a traditional Chinese festival we Chinese have celebrated for over 2, 000 years.
It's one of the three most important lunar festivals in China, along with the Spring Festival and the Mid-Autumn Festival.
The Dragon Boat Festival takes place on the twenty-second of June this year.
Throughout the years, many stories have been told about the beginning of this festival.
Among them, the most famous one is about Qu Yuan, a well-known scholar in ancient China.
He not only wrote good poems but also gave suggestions to the king.
Although he devoted himself to his country, the king didn't like him.
This great person drowned himself in the Miluo River on the 5th day of the 5th Chinese lunar month because his Chu State fell to Qin State.
Local people tried to save him or find his body, but they didn't succeed.
Qu Yuan was later considered as a national hero.
To remember him, every fifth day of the fifth lunar month, people beat drums and go boat racing on the river as they once did to keep fish away from his body.
Dragon boat racing is one of the most important customs Chinese people practice to celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival.
This activity is held widely in China's southern and southeastern areas where there are lots of rivers and lakes.
Lots of love,
Wendy
filled_text_cn: 亲爱的米莉：
你向我询问关于端午节的事情。
现在让我来给你讲讲有关它的一些情况。
端午节是中国的一个传统节日，我们中国人庆祝它已经有两千多年的历史了。
它是中国的三个最重要的农历节日之一，与春节和中秋节并列。
今年的端午节在六月二十二日。
多年来，关于这个节日的起源流传着许多故事。
其中，最著名的一个是关于屈原的，他是中国古代一位著名的学者。
他不仅写得好诗，还向国君提出建议。
尽管他为国家奉献了自己，但国君并不喜欢他。
这位伟人于中国农历五月初五在汨罗江溺水自尽，因为他的楚国被秦国灭亡了。
当地百姓试图营救他或寻找他的尸体，但没有成功。
屈原后来被人们视为民族英雄。
为了纪念他，每年的农历五月初五，人们在江上敲着鼓进行赛龙舟，就像当年他们为了不让鱼吃掉他的身体所做的那样。
赛龙舟是中国人庆祝端午节最重要的习俗之一。
这项活动在中国河湖众多的南方和东南部地区广泛举行。
爱你的，
温迪

sections.title: 典例 3 - Strawberry Picking (摘草莓之旅)
raw_text: Last weekend, it was my little sister Anna's 71. ________ (nine) birthday.
She kept asking us to take her out to play.
It was a lovely day in spring.
After a discussion, we decided to pick strawberries on a farm.
As soon as we arrived 72. ________ the farm, we started picking strawberries.
Anna and I were carrying the baskets 73. ________ Mom and Dad were picking the strawberries.
After picking enough strawberries, we went shopping at 74. ________ small market.
There were all kinds of fresh 75. ________ (vegetable), fruits and snacks.
Dad 76. ________ (buy) each of us an ice cream.
We liked them very much, 77. ________ (especial) when they had the taste of strawberries.
We also 78. ________ (find) some strawberry seeds.
Next year we could plant strawberries in our yard.
Anna enjoyed 79. ________ (her) very much that day.
And she even didn't want to go home when we were leaving.
It was really a 80. ________ (wonder) day.

questions.explanation: 表达第九个生日需要用序数词，nine 的序数词是 ninth（注意去 e 加 th）。
questions.rule_summary: 表示第几岁生日用序数词，nine -> ninth。

questions.explanation: arrive at 后接小地点（如 farm, station, airport），到达农场用 arrive at the farm。
questions.rule_summary: arrive at + 小地点；arrive in + 大地点（城市/国家）。

questions.explanation: 主句 were carrying 与从句 were picking 两个过去进行时的动作同时发生，用 while 引导时间状语从句。
questions.rule_summary: while 引导时间状语从句，常与进行时态连用，表示动作同时进行。

questions.explanation: 此处泛指一个小集市，small 为辅音音素开头的单词，故填不定冠词 a。
questions.rule_summary: 辅音音素开头的单数可数名词前泛指用 a。

questions.explanation: all kinds of 意为各种各样的，修饰可数名词复数，vegetable 的复数形式为 vegetables。
questions.rule_summary: all kinds of + 可数名词复数 / 不可数名词。

questions.explanation: 由全篇时间 Last weekend 可知叙述过去发生的事情，用一般过去时，buy 的过去式为 bought。
questions.rule_summary: 一般过去时表示过去发生的事情；buy 的过去式是不规则变化 bought。

questions.explanation: 此处用副词 especially 修饰后面的状语从句，意为尤其；特别。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词 especial 变为副词 especially 修饰从句或短语。

questions.explanation: 叙述上周末发生的事情，谓语动词使用一般过去时，find 的过去式为 found。
questions.rule_summary: 一般过去时；find 的过去式是不规则变化 found。

questions.explanation: enjoy oneself 为固定短语，意为玩得开心，主语 Anna 是女性，对应的反身代词为 herself。
questions.rule_summary: enjoy oneself 固定搭配，she/her 对应的反身代词是 herself。

questions.explanation: 修饰名词 day 需要填形容词，wonder 是名词，其形容词形式为 wonderful（精彩的；美好的）。
questions.rule_summary: a + adj. + n. 结构；wonder 派生形容词为 wonderful。

filled_text: Last weekend, it was my little sister Anna's ninth birthday.
She kept asking us to take her out to play.
It was a lovely day in spring.
After a discussion, we decided to pick strawberries on a farm.
As soon as we arrived at the farm, we started picking strawberries.
Anna and I were carrying the baskets while Mom and Dad were picking the strawberries.
After picking enough strawberries, we went shopping at a small market.
There were all kinds of fresh vegetables, fruits and snacks.
Dad bought each of us an ice cream.
We liked them very much, especially when they had the taste of strawberries.
We also found some strawberry seeds.
Next year we could plant strawberries in our yard.
Anna enjoyed herself very much that day.
And she even didn't want to go home when we were leaving.
It was really a wonderful day.
filled_text_cn: 上周末是我小妹妹安娜九岁的生日。
她一直要求我们带她出去玩。
那是一个美好的春日。
经过讨论，我们决定去农场摘草莓。
我们一到达农场，就开始摘草莓。
安娜和我提着篮子，爸爸妈妈则在摘草莓。
摘够了草莓后，我们去一个小市场买东西。
那里有各种各样的新鲜蔬菜、水果和零食。
爸爸给我们每人买了一个冰淇淋。
我们非常喜欢它们，尤其是它们带有草莓的味道时。
我们还找到了一些草莓种子。
明年我们可以在院子里种草莓了。
那天安娜玩得非常开心。
我们离开时，她甚至都不想回家。
这真是一个美妙的日子。

sections.title: Passage 1 - Junior High Memories (初中回忆)
raw_text: How time flies!
Now we are in the 1. ________ (nine) grade.
Our junior high school years will come to an end in several months, 2. ________ I still remember the first time when we came to the school.
We came from different places and we met 3. ________ the first time, so we didn't know each other.
In the past three years, we have not only experienced lots of difficulties, but also had many beautiful 4. ________ (memory) in our school life.
We once 5. ________ (fight), and then we made peace with each other.
We are good friends now.
I remembered that our school held 6. ________ sports meeting last autumn.
We came to school 7. ________ (early) than usual.
Although it was September and it was a little cold, we didn't feel cold at all.
We ran, jumped and cheered for 8. ________ (we) teammates.
9. ________ (luck), we won the first prize in our school.
How happy we were!
I will put all of these 10. ________ (value) things in my heart forever.

questions.explanation: the ninth grade 意为九年级，空前有定冠词 the，表示年级用序数词 ninth。
questions.rule_summary: the + 序数词 + grade 表示几年级；nine 变序数词为 ninth。

questions.explanation: 前半句初中生活快结束了与后半句仍然记得刚进校的时刻构成转折关系，用并列连词 but 连接。
questions.rule_summary: but 连接两个分句表示意思上的转折。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定短语 (for the first time)
questions.explanation: for the first time 为固定介词短语，意为第一次；初次。
questions.rule_summary: for the first time 固定搭配，意为第一次。

questions.explanation: many 修饰可数名词复数，以辅音字母加 y 结尾的名词变复数需变 y 为 i 再加 -es，故填 memories。
questions.rule_summary: many + 可数名词复数；辅音字母+y结尾名词变复数：变y为i加es。

questions.explanation: 由 once 以及并列动词 made peace 可知叙述初中过去发生的经历，用一般过去时，fight 的过去式为 fought。
questions.rule_summary: 一般过去时；fight 的过去式是不规则变化 fought。

questions.explanation: sports meeting 为单数名词短语，泛指一场运动会，sports 以辅音音素开头，故填不定冠词 a。
questions.rule_summary: 辅音音素开头的单数可数名词前泛指用不定冠词 a。

questions.explanation: 空后有比较连词 than，early 修饰动词 came 作副词，其比较级为 earlier。
questions.rule_summary: than 提示使用比较级；early 的比较级为 earlier。

questions.explanation: 修饰名词 teammates 需要用形容词性物主代词，we 的形容词性物主代词为 our（我们的）。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词性物主代词修饰名词；we -> our。

questions.explanation: 位于句首用逗号隔开修饰整个句子，表示幸运的是，用副词 Luckily，句首首字母大写。
questions.rule_summary: 副词位于句首作评注性状语修饰全句；luck(名) -> lucky(形) -> luckily(副)。

questions.explanation: 修饰名词 things 需要填形容词，value 是名词，其形容词形式为 valuable（珍贵的；宝贵的）。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词作定语修饰名词；value 派生形容词为 valuable。

filled_text: How time flies!
Now we are in the ninth grade.
Our junior high school years will come to an end in several months, but I still remember the first time when we came to the school.
We came from different places and we met for the first time, so we didn't know each other.
In the past three years, we have not only experienced lots of difficulties, but also had many beautiful memories in our school life.
We once fought, and then we made peace with each other.
We are good friends now.
I remembered that our school held a sports meeting last autumn.
We came to school earlier than usual.
Although it was September and it was a little cold, we didn't feel cold at all.
We ran, jumped and cheered for our teammates.
Luckily, we won the first prize in our school.
How happy we were!
I will put all of these valuable things in my heart forever.
filled_text_cn: 时间过得真快！
现在我们上九年级了。
我们的初中生活将在几个月后结束，但我依然记得我们来到这所学校的第一天。
我们来自不同的地方，初次相遇，所以彼此并不认识。
在过去的三年里，我们的学校生活不仅经历过许多困难，也有过许多美好的回忆。
我们曾有过争吵，但后来又重归于好。
我们现在是好朋友了。
我记得去年秋天我们学校举行了一场运动会。
我们比平时更早地来到了学校。
虽然当时是九月份，还有点冷，但我们一点也不觉得冷。
我们奔跑、跳跃，为队友们呐喊助威。
幸运的是，我们在学校里获得了一等奖。
我们是多么高兴啊！
我会永远把所有这些珍贵的东西记在心里。

sections.title: Passage 2 - The Swans and the Turtle (天鹅与乌龟)
raw_text: There was a lake in a small village.
Two swans (天鹅) and a turtle lived there.
They were good 11. ________ (friend).
One year, there were no rains and the lake started 12. ________ (dry) up.
"We have to find another place to live in," said the turtle.
"We will fly around and look 13. ________ a suitable place," said the swans.
Both the swans flew in different directions.
A little distance away, one of the swans saw a much 14. ________ (large) lake.
He flew back to tell the others.
Three of them were very excited.
But one swan said, "The two of us can fly there quickly.
But you move very 15. ________ (slow).
You will never reach there."
The turtle said, "You bring me a stick.
I will hold the center of the stick in my mouth.
Both of you can hold the stick on either side."
"It is a very good idea, 16. ________ you should make sure you do not open your mouth for any reason.
If you do, you will fall to death," warned one of the swans.
The turtle agreed.
As they flew over the village, people 17. ________ (run) out into the streets to look at this amazing sight.
"18. ________ clever birds!
They are carrying a turtle on a stick!" said one man.
"It was my idea.
I am the clever one.
I need to let them 19. ________ (know)," thought the turtle.
He opened 20. ________ (he) mouth to explain, but before the turtle could say anything, fell and was badly hurt.
At last, the two swans landed at the big lake, which would be their home from then on.
"If he had kept his promise, he would be happy with us now," said one swan.

questions.explanation: 主语 They 指代两只天鹅和一只乌龟，为复数概念，作表语的名词应用复数 friends。
questions.rule_summary: 主系表结构中，复数主语对应的名词表语用复数形式。

questions.explanation: start to do sth. 或 start doing sth. 表示开始做某事，此处 dry 变为动名词 drying（或 to dry），故填 drying。
questions.rule_summary: start doing sth. / start to do sth. 开始做某事。

questions.explanation: look for 为固定短语，意为寻找，天鹅四处飞行去寻找合适的新居住地。
questions.rule_summary: look for 寻找；look at 看；look after 照顾；look up 查阅。

questions.explanation: much 经常用来修饰比较级表示……得多，large 的比较级为 larger。
questions.rule_summary: much / even / far 修饰比较级；large 比较级为 larger。

questions.explanation: 修饰动词 move 需要用副词，形容词 slow 的副词形式为 slowly（缓慢地）。
questions.rule_summary: 副词修饰动词；slow(形) -> slowly(副)。

questions.explanation: 前面这是个好主意与后面但是你千万不能张嘴构成转折，用并列连词 but 连接。
questions.rule_summary: but 表示前后分句的转折关系。

questions.explanation: 由从句 As they flew 中的过去式 flew 可知主句叙述过去发生的动作，run 的过去式为 ran。
questions.rule_summary: 主从复合句时态一致；run 的过去式是不规则变化 ran。

questions.explanation: 感叹句中心词为复数名词 clever birds，感叹名词短语用 What (What + adj. + pl. n.!)，句首大写。
questions.rule_summary: 感叹句结构：What + (a/an) + adj. + n. ! / How + adj./adv. + 主谓！

questions.grammar_point_name: 使役动词后接省略to的不定式
questions.explanation: let sb. do sth. 为固定用法，使役动词 let 后的复合宾语中动词用原形（省略 to 的不定式）。
questions.rule_summary: let / make / have sb. do sth. 接不带 to 的动词不定式。

questions.explanation: 修饰名词 mouth 需要填形容词性物主代词，he 的形容词性物主代词为 his（他的）。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词性物主代词作定语修饰名词；he -> his。

filled_text: There was a lake in a small village.
Two swans and a turtle lived there.
They were good friends.
One year, there were no rains and the lake started drying up.
"We have to find another place to live in," said the turtle.
"We will fly around and look for a suitable place," said the swans.
Both the swans flew in different directions.
A little distance away, one of the swans saw a much larger lake.
He flew back to tell the others.
Three of them were very excited.
But one swan said, "The two of us can fly there quickly.
But you move very slowly.
You will never reach there."
The turtle said, "You bring me a stick.
I will hold the center of the stick in my mouth.
Both of you can hold the stick on either side."
"It is a very good idea, but you should make sure you do not open your mouth for any reason.
If you do, you will fall to death," warned one of the swans.
The turtle agreed.
As they flew over the village, people ran out into the streets to look at this amazing sight.
"What clever birds!
They are carrying a turtle on a stick!" said one man.
"It was my idea.
I am the clever one.
I need to let them know," thought the turtle.
He opened his mouth to explain, but before the turtle could say anything, fell and was badly hurt.
At last, the two swans landed at the big lake, which would be their home from then on.
"If he had kept his promise, he would be happy with us now," said one swan.
filled_text_cn: 一个小村庄里有一个湖。
两只天鹅和一只乌龟住在那里。
它们是好朋友。
有一年，天不下雨，湖水开始干涸了。
“我们得找另一个地方住，”乌龟说。
“我们要飞到四周去寻找一个合适的地方，”天鹅说。
两只天鹅飞向了不同的方向。
在不远处，其中一只天鹅看到一个大得多的湖。
他飞回来把这个消息告诉了大家。
他们三个都非常兴奋。
但其中一只天鹅说：“我们俩可以很快飞到那里。
但你行动非常慢。
你永远也到不了那里。”
乌龟说：“你们给我找根棍子来。
我用嘴咬住棍子的中间。
你们两个分别叼住棍子的两端。”
“这是一个非常好的主意，但你一定要确保无论出于什么原因都不能张开嘴。
如果你这样做了，你会摔死的，”其中一只天鹅警告说。
乌龟同意了。
当它们从村庄上空飞过时，人们跑上街头观看这奇妙的景象。
“多聪明的鸟啊！
它们用棍子抬着一只乌龟！”一个人说。
“这主意是我想出来的。
我才是聪明的那个。
我得让他们知道，”乌龟心想。
他张开嘴想要解释，但还没等乌龟说出什么，就掉了下去并受了重伤。
最后，两只天鹅降落在了那个大湖边，从那时起这里就成了它们的家。
“如果他遵守了诺言，他现在就能和我们一起快乐了，”一只天鹅说。

sections.title: Passage 3 - Isis and Four-leaf Clovers (四叶草女孩)
raw_text: Isis is 11 years old.
Because of physical illness, Isis was staying 21. ________ home all day and feeling bored.
Like many 22. ________ (kid), she was looking for fun things to do.
Isis 23. ________ (spend) a lot of time at her grandmother's home.
The house has a large yard.
There Isis found her first four-leaf clover (四叶草).
A clover is a small plant that 24. ________ (usual) has three leaves.
Many people think that a four-leaf clover 25. ________ (bring) good luck.
Isis took that special clover to her grandmother.
"This is 26. ________ (amaze)," she said excitedly.
Isis began to learn more about the plant.
"I want to look for more by 27. ________ (I)," she said.
Isis began searching.
She looked in her grandmother's large yard, her own yard and a nearby park.
So far, Isis has collected more than 500 of them.
28. ________ the clovers slowly turned brown and died.
Isis did not know how to keep them in good shape.
Luckily, her grandmother had an idea.
She taught Isis to iron (烫平) them between pieces of waxed paper (蜡纸), 29. ________ they wouldn't turn brown.
Illness has been hard on many kids.
Isis said her new hobby really helped.
"It gave me something to do and spending time outdoors and exploring nature made me feel much 30. ________ (good)," she said to her grandmother.

questions.explanation: stay at home 为固定搭配，意为待在家里。
questions.rule_summary: at home 在家里，固定介词搭配。

questions.explanation: many 修饰可数名词复数，kid 的复数形式为 kids。
questions.rule_summary: many + 可数名词复数。

questions.explanation: 由后句 There Isis found 可知讲述过去发生的故事，用一般过去时，spend 的过去式为 spent。
questions.rule_summary: 一般过去时；spend 的过去式是不规则变化 spent。

questions.explanation: 修饰动词 has 需要用频度副词，形容词 usual 的副词形式为 usually（通常）。
questions.rule_summary: 频度副词通常置于实义动词之前；usual -> usually。

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般现在时第三人称单数
questions.explanation: 主句 Many people think 为一般现在时，宾语从句描述人们普遍的看法与规律，主语 a four-leaf clover 为单数，谓语用三单形式 brings。
questions.rule_summary: 一般现在时单数第三人称主语，谓语动词加 -s / -es。

questions.explanation: 主语 This 指代找到四叶草这件事，描述事物令人惊喜用 -ing 结尾的形容词 amazing。
questions.rule_summary: 物作主语修饰事物特征用 -ing 形容词 (amazing/interesting)；人作主语感受用 -ed 形容词 (amazed/interested)。

questions.explanation: by oneself 为固定搭配，意为亲自；独自，I 对应的反身代词为 myself。
questions.rule_summary: by oneself 独自/亲自；I 对应的反身代词是 myself。

questions.explanation: 前文提到收集了 500 多棵，后文提到四叶草慢慢枯黄死去了，前后语义转折且空后有逗号隔开，用 However，句首大写。
questions.rule_summary: however 作副词表示转折，常用于句首并用逗号隔开。

questions.grammar_point_name: 目的/结果连词 (so that / so)
questions.explanation: 前句教她在蜡纸间烫平，后句这样它们就不会变黄，两者构成因果/结果目的关系，用 so (或 so that) 连接。
questions.rule_summary: so 引导结果状语从句或顺承关系，意为因此；以便。

questions.explanation: 空前有程度副词 much 修饰比较级，feel 为系动词后接形容词比较级 better（感觉好多了）。
questions.rule_summary: much 修饰比较级；good/well 的比较级是不规则变化 better。

filled_text: Isis is 11 years old.
Because of physical illness, Isis was staying at home all day and feeling bored.
Like many kids, she was looking for fun things to do.
Isis spent a lot of time at her grandmother's home.
The house has a large yard.
There Isis found her first four-leaf clover.
A clover is a small plant that usually has three leaves.
Many people think that a four-leaf clover brings good luck.
Isis took that special clover to her grandmother.
"This is amazing," she said excitedly.
Isis began to learn more about the plant.
"I want to look for more by myself," she said.
Isis began searching.
She looked in her grandmother's large yard, her own yard and a nearby park.
So far, Isis has collected more than 500 of them.
However the clovers slowly turned brown and died.
Isis did not know how to keep them in good shape.
Luckily, her grandmother had an idea.
She taught Isis to iron them between pieces of waxed paper, so they wouldn't turn brown.
Illness has been hard on many kids.
Isis said her new hobby really helped.
"It gave me something to do and spending time outdoors and exploring nature made me feel much better," she said to her grandmother.
filled_text_cn: 艾西斯11岁了。
由于身体生病，艾西斯整天待在家里，感觉很无聊。
和许多孩子一样，她在寻找好玩的事情做。
艾西斯花了很多时间在她奶奶家。
房子有一个大院子。
在那里，艾西斯找到了她的第一株四叶草。
三叶草是一种通常有三片叶子的小植物。
许多人认为四叶草会带来好运。
艾西斯把那株特别的三叶草拿给她奶奶看。
“这太神奇了，”她兴奋地说。
艾西斯开始更多地了解这种植物。
“我想自己找更多，”她说。
艾西斯开始寻找。
她在奶奶的大院子、她自己的院子和一个附近的公园里寻找。
到目前为止，艾西斯已经收集了500多株。
然而，三叶草慢慢变成了褐色并枯死了。
艾西斯不知道如何保持它们的良好状态。
幸运的是，她奶奶有个主意。
她教艾西斯把它们夹在蜡纸之间熨烫，这样它们就不会变色了。
疾病对许多孩子来说一直很难熬。
艾西斯说她的新爱好真的很有帮助。
她对奶奶说：“这给了我一些事情做，而且花时间在户外探索大自然让我感觉好多了。”

sections.title: Passage 4 - The History of Weiqi (围棋的历史与传播)
raw_text: Games come and go.
Only few remain popular after 31. ________ (hundred) of years.
Nowadays archaeologists (考古学家) have found paintings and writings that tell us about ancient games.
Some of these games are similar 32. ________ the games people still play today.
One of 33. ________ (they) is weiqi.
The history of weiqi in China goes back to more than 2,000 years.
Some scholars believe it may go back to over 4,000 years!
This was the game of kings and 34. ________ (gentleman) during the time of Confucius.
As time went by, the game 35. ________ (spread) to Korea.
Then it reached Japan around 700 AD.
This game was 36. ________ (call) Go in Japan.
However, it didn't really become popular in Japan 37. ________ the 1600s.
At that time, four Go schools were set up in Japan.
Students from the schools competed in 38. ________ (nation) competitions each year.
The 39. ________ (win) was named the Go Minister of Japan for a year!
Today, weiqi is played all 40. ________ the world.
Two astronauts even played the game in space.
One of the astronauts was from Japan, and the other was from the USA.

questions.explanation: hundreds of 为固定搭配，意为数以百计的；几百年的，表示不确切的概数时用复数形式加 of。
questions.rule_summary: 基数词概数表达：hundreds / thousands / millions of + 名词复数。

questions.grammar_point_name: 形容词介词搭配 (be similar to)
questions.explanation: be similar to 为固定搭配，意为与……相似。
questions.rule_summary: be similar to 与……相似；be different from 与……不同；the same as 和……一样。

questions.explanation: 介词 of 后接代词宾格，they 的宾格形式为 them。
questions.rule_summary: 介词后接人称代词宾格形式；they -> them。

questions.explanation: and 连接并列成分，与前面的复数名词 kings 并列，gentleman 变复数为 gentlemen。
questions.rule_summary: and 连接并列名词形式保持一致；gentleman 的复数是不规则变化 gentlemen。

questions.explanation: 由从句 As time went by 中的 went 可知时态为一般过去时，spread 的过去式与原形相同，仍为 spread。
questions.rule_summary: 一般过去时；spread 原形、过去式、过去分词同形 (spread-spread-spread)。

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般过去时的被动语态
questions.explanation: 主语 This game 与 call 是被动关系，由 was 可知此处填过去分词 called 构成一般过去时的被动语态。
questions.rule_summary: was/were + 过去分词构成一般过去时被动语态。

questions.explanation: not... until... 为固定结构，意为直到……才……，表示直到 17 世纪围棋才在日本真正流行起来。
questions.rule_summary: not... until... 意为直到……才……。

questions.explanation: 修饰名词 competitions 需要填形容词，nation 是名词，其形容词形式为 national（全国的）。
questions.rule_summary: 形容词修饰名词；nation(名) -> national(形)。

questions.explanation: 定冠词 The 后作主语且被任命为大臣，需要表示人的名词 winner（获胜者），由 was 可知填单数形式。
questions.rule_summary: The + 名词作主语；win(动) -> winner(名词，获胜者)。

questions.grammar_point_name: 介词固定短语 (all over the world)
questions.explanation: all over the world 为固定短语，意为全世界；世界各地。
questions.rule_summary: all over the world / all around the world 全世界。

filled_text: Games come and go.
Only few remain popular after hundreds of years.
Nowadays archaeologists have found paintings and writings that tell us about ancient games.
Some of these games are similar to the games people still play today.
One of them is weiqi.
The history of weiqi in China goes back to more than 2,000 years.
Some scholars believe it may go back to over 4,000 years!
This was the game of kings and gentlemen during the time of Confucius.
As time went by, the game spread to Korea.
Then it reached Japan around 700 AD.
This game was called Go in Japan.
However, it didn't really become popular in Japan until the 1600s.
At that time, four Go schools were set up in Japan.
Students from the schools competed in national competitions each year.
The winner was named the Go Minister of Japan for a year!
Today, weiqi is played all over the world.
Two astronauts even played the game in space.
One of the astronauts was from Japan, and the other was from the USA.
filled_text_cn: 游戏来来往往。
只有少数游戏在几百年后依然受欢迎。
如今，考古学家们已经发现了讲述古代游戏的绘画和文字。
其中一些游戏与人们今天仍在玩的游戏相似。
其中之一就是围棋。
中国围棋的历史可以追溯到2000多年以前。
一些学者认为它的历史甚至可以追溯到4000多年以前！
在孔子生活的时代，这是国王和绅士们玩的游戏。
随着时间的推移，这项游戏传播到了朝鲜。
大约在公元700年，它传到了日本。
在日本，这项游戏被称为“Go”。
然而，直到17世纪，它才真正在日本流行起来。
当时，日本设立了四所围棋学校。
这些学校的学生每年都会参加全国比赛。
获胜者被封为一年的日本围棋大臣！
如今，世界各地的人们都在玩围棋。
甚至有两名宇航员在太空中下过围棋。
其中一名宇航员来自日本，另一名来自美国。

sections.title: Passage 5 - Studying in Beijing (Fred的北京留学信)
raw_text: Hi Mary,
How time flies!
I have been in Beijing for 3 months!
I have been rather busy with the course and making new friends 41. ________ I got here.
My class is a real mix of nationalities: English, Russian, Thai, Italian, Spanish and Brazilian.
My host family are 42. ________ (real) nice.
The parents, Liu and Wu, are very friendly and kind.
Their young children 43. ________ (call) Yan and Dong.
They're both in primary school and are very sweet, but sometimes a bit annoying too.
If I am asked to watch the film The Lion King 44. ________ them one more time, I'm going crazy!
We live so close to the school that 45. ________ only takes us five minutes to walk there.
It's only a short bus ride from Wangfujing Shopping Centre, and it's convenient 46. ________ (buy) everything there.
As you know, there are many ancient buildings here in Beijing.
The Forbidden City is 47. ________ (famous) of all.
Our class 48. ________ (go) on a school trip to visit it last week.
We were so lucky!
There was a traditional festival at that moment.
The Forbidden City is such 49. ________ amazing place to see!
Next time I will send you some 50. ________ (photo) of places of interest in Beijing.
Yours,
Fred

questions.grammar_point_name: 时间状语从句从属连词 (since)
questions.explanation: 主句使用现在完成时 (have been rather busy)，从句使用一般过去时 (got here)，表示自从我到达这里以来用连词 since。
questions.rule_summary: 主句现在完成时 + since + 从句一般过去时。

questions.explanation: 修饰形容词 nice 需要用副词，real 的副词形式为 really（真正地；确实）。
questions.rule_summary: 副词修饰形容词；real -> really。

questions.grammar_point_name: 一般现在时的被动语态
questions.explanation: 主语 Their young children 与 call 是被动关系（被称为/名字叫），描述现在的事实用一般现在时被动语态，主语为复数，故填 are called。
questions.rule_summary: 一般现在时被动语态；复数主语用 are + 过去分词。

questions.explanation: 此处表示和他们一起看电影，with 表示伴随、同……一起。
questions.rule_summary: with sb. 和某人一起，表伴随。

questions.explanation: It takes sb. some time to do sth. 为固定句型，it 在此处作形式主语指代花费时间。
questions.rule_summary: It takes sb. some time to do sth. 做某事花费某人多长时间（it 作形式主语）。

questions.explanation: it is convenient to do sth. 为固定句型，it 作形式主语，动词不定式 to buy 作真正的主语。
questions.rule_summary: it is + adj. + to do sth. 不定式作真正主语。

questions.explanation: 由 of all（在所有古建筑中）表示全部范围可知此处应用最高级，最高级前加定冠词 the，故填 the most famous。
questions.rule_summary: of all 表示全部范围，形容词用最高级，且其前需加 the。

questions.explanation: 由时间状语 last week 可知动作发生在过去，用一般过去时，go 的过去式为 went。
questions.rule_summary: last week / yesterday 等过去时间标志词用一般过去时；go 过去式为 went。

questions.explanation: such a/an + adj. + 可数名词单数 为固定搭配，amazing 以元音音素开头，故填不定冠词 an。
questions.rule_summary: such + a/an + 形容词 + 单数可数名词；元音音素前用 an。

questions.explanation: some 修饰可数名词复数，photo 的复数形式直接加 -s 为 photos。
questions.rule_summary: some + 可数名词复数；photo 变复数直接加 s 为 photos。

filled_text: Hi Mary,
How time flies!
I have been in Beijing for 3 months!
I have been rather busy with the course and making new friends since I got here.
My class is a real mix of nationalities: English, Russian, Thai, Italian, Spanish and Brazilian.
My host family are really nice.
The parents, Liu and Wu, are very friendly and kind.
Their young children are called Yan and Dong.
They're both in primary school and are very sweet, but sometimes a bit annoying too.
If I am asked to watch the film The Lion King with them one more time, I'm going crazy!
We live so close to the school that it only takes us five minutes to walk there.
It's only a short bus ride from Wangfujing Shopping Centre, and it's convenient to buy everything there.
As you know, there are many ancient buildings here in Beijing.
The Forbidden City is the most famous of all.
Our class went on a school trip to visit it last week.
We were so lucky!
There was a traditional festival at that moment.
The Forbidden City is such an amazing place to see!
Next time I will send you some photos of places of interest in Beijing.
Yours,
Fred
filled_text_cn: 嗨，玛丽：
时间过得真快！
我已经在北京待了 3 个月了！
自从来到这里，我一直忙于上课和结交新朋友。
我的班级是一个真正的多元国籍组合：英国、俄罗斯、泰国、意大利、西班牙和巴西。
我的寄宿家庭真的很好。
父母刘和吴非常友好和善良。
他们的小孩子分别叫燕和东。
他们俩都在上小学，非常可爱，但有时也让人有点头疼。
如果有人再叫我和他们一起看电影《狮子王》，我就要疯了！
我们住得离学校很近，步行只需五分钟。
这里离王府井购物中心只有短短的车程，在那里买东西很方便。
如你所知，北京有许多古建筑。
紫禁城是其中最著名的一个。
上周我们班组织了一次学校旅行去参观它。
我们太幸运了！
当时正赶上一个传统节日。
紫禁城真是一个令人惊叹的参观好地方！
下次我将给你寄一些北京名胜古迹的照片。
你真诚的，
弗雷德
